name: 英雄联盟
description: 5v5 MOBA 竞技游戏，国服由腾讯运营。
intro: 英雄联盟是一款 5v5 MOBA 竞技游戏，选择英雄组队对抗，拥有排位赛、大乱斗等模式。国服由腾讯运营，官网可下载客户端。

en.name: League of Legends
en.description: 5v5 MOBA with ranked and ARAM modes, operated by Tencent in China.
en.intro: League of Legends is a 5v5 MOBA where players pick champions and fight as a team, with ranked and ARAM modes. The Chinese server is operated by Tencent and the client is available from the official site.

name: 无畏契约
description: 5v5 战术射击游戏，拳头游戏出品。
intro: 无畏契约（VALORANT）是一款 5v5 战术射击游戏，结合英雄技能与枪法对抗。国服由腾讯代理，官网可下载客户端。

en.name: VALORANT
en.intro: VALORANT is a 5v5 tactical shooter combining agent abilities with gunplay. The Chinese server is published by Tencent and the client is available from the official site.

name: 永劫无间
description: 多人动作竞技游戏，武侠风格。
intro: 永劫无间是一款多人动作竞技游戏，以武侠为背景，支持单排、三排和大乱斗，官网可下载客户端。

en.name: Naraka: Bladepoint
en.description: Multiplayer action battle royale with a wuxia setting.
en.intro: Naraka: Bladepoint is a multiplayer action game with a wuxia setting, supporting solo, trio and brawl modes. The client is available from the official site.

name: 三角洲行动
description: 第一人称射击游戏，含大战场和摸金模式。
intro: 三角洲行动是一款第一人称射击游戏，提供大战场、危险行动等模式，国服由腾讯运营，官网可下载。

en.name: Delta Force
en.description: First-person shooter with large-scale warfare and extraction modes.
en.intro: Delta Force is a first-person shooter featuring large-scale warfare and hazard operations (extraction) modes. The Chinese server is operated by Tencent and the client is available from the official site.

name: 剑网3
intro: 剑网3是一款武侠 MMORPG，拥有门派、轻功和大型副本，国服由西山居运营，官网可下载客户端。

en.name: JX3
en.intro: JX3 is a wuxia MMORPG with schools, qinggong movement and large raids. The Chinese server is operated by Seasun and the client is available from the official site.

name: 逆水寒
description: 网易武侠 MMORPG，画面精致。
intro: 逆水寒是网易出品的武侠 MMORPG，以画面和剧情著称，官网可下载客户端。

en.name: Justice Online
en.description: NetEase wuxia MMORPG with detailed visuals.
en.intro: Justice Online is a wuxia MMORPG from NetEase known for its visuals and storytelling. The client is available from the official site.

name: 黑神话：悟空
description: 国产动作角色扮演游戏，西游记题材。
intro: 黑神话：悟空是一款国产动作角色扮演游戏，以西游记为背景，通过 Steam、WeGame 等平台购买和下载。

en.name: Black Myth: Wukong
en.description: Chinese action RPG based on Journey to the West.
en.intro: Black Myth: Wukong is a Chinese action RPG inspired by Journey to the West. It is purchased and downloaded through Steam, WeGame and other platforms.

name: 幻兽帕鲁
description: 开放世界生存建造游戏，收集帕鲁。
intro: 幻兽帕鲁是一款开放世界生存建造游戏，可以捕捉帕鲁、建造基地和战斗，通过 Steam 购买下载。

en.name: Palworld
en.description: Open-world survival crafting game about collecting Pals.
en.intro: Palworld is an open-world survival crafting game where you catch Pals, build bases and fight. It is purchased and downloaded through Steam.
